name: steph38
caption:
STILL STEPH 🎮🏀 Minnesota passed on him twice. At 38, he's dropping 31.3 a night.

• 2009 draft: Minnesota takes two other point guards at 5 and 6, we take Steph at #7
• Born March 14, 1988: he's 38 now
• First 8 games: 31.3 PPG on 44.7% from three
• 98.5% from the line

Can he keep this up all season? 👇

beats.head: PICK 7
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: Minnesota had two straight picks, and took two other point guards. We took Steph Curry at seven.
beats.dlg: MINNESOTA PASSES TWICE...|WE TAKE STEPH AT 7.

beats.head: AGE 38
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: Now he's thirty-eight. Everybody said he'd slow down by now.

beats.head: 8 GAMES IN
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: Through eight games: thirty-one point three points a night, on forty-four point seven percent from three.

beats.head: FREE THROWS
beats.name: STEPH
beats.vo: And at the line? Ninety-eight point five percent.

beats.head: STILL STEPH
beats.vo: Thirty-one a night at thirty-eight. Can he keep this up all season? Comment below.
